title: TenantFacilitySpecialty
description: Represents the specialty information for a healthcare provider facility.  References the Specialty entity.

effectiveDate.description: The date when the specialty became effective.

terminationDate.description: The date when the specialty was terminated.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if the specialty is primary.

isBoardCertified.description: Indicates if the specialty is board certified.

isContracted.description: Indicates if the specialty is contracted.

isPracticing.description: Indicates if the specialty is currently being practiced.
